cli.build.behaviour.attributes: [{page}] a behaviour card without a kind or a title
cli.build.behaviour.duplicate.help: give each card its own id, or none
cli.build.behaviour.file: [{file}] not a valid file of kinds of behaviour, at {at}
cli.build.behaviour.file.help: follow schemas/behaviours.schema.json; the words of the explicit answers (answers) belong to the kit
cli.build.behaviour.fileMissing: the file of kinds of behaviour {file} does not exist
cli.build.behaviour.kind.help: one of: {known}; or add your own with config.behaviours.file
cli.build.behaviour.kindTwice: [{file}] the kind “{kind}” takes the spelling “{spelling}”, already used
cli.build.behaviour.kindTwice.help: give it another id and other aliases
cli.build.behaviour.missing.help: answer each rubric on a “Rubric: value” line, or write “n/a — reason” or “unknown — question”
cli.build.behaviour.unknown.help: give the card id="{id}", or fix the behaviour named by the scenario
cli.build.scenario.steps: [{page}] scenario “{title}”: no Then step after a Given or a When
cli.build.scenario.steps.help: write one step per line: Given …, When …, Then … (Soit, Quand, Alors)
cli.build.epic.duplicate: [{section}] epic “{id}” is the id of two groups
cli.build.epic.duplicate.help: give each group its own epic id (E-01, E-02…): the first one is kept
cli.build.epic.unknown: [{page}] the sheet names the epic “{id}”, which no group of the table of contents declares
cli.build.epic.unknown.help: declare it on a group ("epic": "{id}"), or leave the sheet in its group's epic
cli.build.story.outside: [{page}] user story “{id}” is not in a feature sheet: the backlog (::stories{}) leaves it out
cli.build.story.outside.help: write the story in its feature's sheet (template "feature", with a "feature" id in toc.json)
cli.build.backlog.ref: “{id}”: “{ref}” is no ticket reference the kit reads; it is kept as written, without a link
cli.build.backlog.ref.help: write it as ADO#1234, AB#1234, PROJ-123, owner/repo#42 or group/sub/project#7
cli.build.backlog.field: [{page}] “{field}” is a field of a feature sheet: on this page it is ignored
cli.build.backlog.field.help: give the page "template": "feature" and a "feature" id, or remove "{field}"
cli.build.story.attributes: [{page}] a user story without an id or a title
cli.build.story.duplicate.help: a story is defined once; cite it elsewhere with [[story …]]
cli.build.story.unknown.help: define it once with :::story{id="{id}" title="…"}, or fix the id
